briefing: The station is dark. One terminal still has power, and it only understands C. Let's get it to say something.
Oxygen readouts are garbage. Variables, types and printf will make them make sense again.
Power has to be split across modules exactly. Arithmetic, remainders and a few traps await.
The airlock opens for anyone. Teach it to decide.
The engines need a steady pulse. Repetition, without copy-pasting.
Build routines the drones can run again and again.
The cargo manifest and the comms buffer are both just rows of values. Time to read them.
The core's wiring is addresses pointing at addresses. This is the big one.
Something keeps taking memory and never giving it back.
The flight recorder is full of logs. Read them, and handle what goes wrong.
A function that takes any number of arguments, like printf itself.
Alarms interrupt whatever you're doing. Learn to catch them.
Two programs talking through a socket. Send the mayday.
Many drones, one job, no collisions. Bring the station fully online.
